entries.08570a7f62fa8978: This business is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Kyaria Indekkusu Co., Ltd. and Howaito Kyaria Co., Ltd. Under an “aggregation model” that links information from multiple job sites and rental property sites with its own sites, it provides a mechanism that lets users search for information in one place and register, apply, or make inquiries to multiple sites collectively. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,917 million, up 26.6% from the prior year.
entries.13c270e1adbafe9c: A holding company that, through subsidiaries, operates a marketing business running sites that aggregate job and real estate listings for searching, and a DX business covering contract management, sales support and more.
entries.1b39adb67bbdad4c: It operates the job change information site “CAREER INDEX,” the part-time and temp job information site “Lacotto,” the job change information site specializing in the fashion and apparel industry “Fashion HR,” and the performance-based recruitment support service “Adopt Admin.” It also provides a service that carries Hello Work job listings and allows users to prepare and mail application documents. Howaito Kyaria Co., Ltd. operates the job placement service “Howaito Kyaria” and also provides its own marketing know-how to other job placement operators. It also runs a “job sharing business (alliance marketing),” which provides the group's job platform to candidates for whom matching has not been established at staffing agencies or similar firms. Revenue by service for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,108 million for job change services and ¥818 million for part-time and temp services.

entries.80c6101db1f9fd53: This business applies the aggregation model to real estate rentals. For individuals, it operates rental information sites “DOOR Chintai” and “Cashback Chintai,” providing property information services specializing in “no security deposit or key money.” For corporate customers, it operates “JUST FIT OFFICE,” a flexible office information site that gathers information on rental offices, shared offices and coworking spaces. Revenue by service for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥990 million.

entries.c5187e694dcac5d3: This business is carried out by three consolidated subsidiaries: ContractS Co., Ltd., Sales X Co., Ltd. and Marginal Co., Ltd. It provides services that support the digitalization of business operations such as corporate contract management, sales activities and recruitment screening. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,196 million, down 0.3% from the prior year.

entries.d5e2c63e1df9a1a1: This is a system provided by ContractS Co., Ltd. that supports the DX of corporate contracts and contract management. It handles everything in a consistent flow, from drafting and legal review before signing, through execution, to document management after signing, and it can digitize past paper contracts for centralized management. It achieved full-year profitability in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.da432d427502cce9: This is an online interview system provided by Marginal Co., Ltd. for businesses and schools that require mass hiring and mass screening. It has schedule management and recorded-interview screening functions and also accommodates customization requests from each client. The company's development resources are also used as a technology base for the group as a whole.
